name: rbac
removeWarnings: Custom roles stored in the organizationRole table survive this removal, and nothing reads them once packages/auth/src/rbac.ts is gone. Members holding a custom role resolve to the statements of a role name that no longer exists, which is no permissions at all. Reassign them to a base role before you remove this module.
Every route written against requireCan stops compiling once packages/auth/src/rbac.ts is gone. Rewrite them on requireTenant, or delete them, before you remove this module.

This module owns packages/api/src/routes/projects.ts, the permission-gated copy of multitenant's example, so removing it deletes that file while the /projects mount stays. Run saasaloy add multitenant to restore the ungated copy.
